project.title: Metagenomic sequencing of activated sludge and digestion sludge from full-scale WWTP
project.description: In order to reveal microbial community structure and to obtain the broad-spectrum profile of antibiotic resistance gene in a full-scale WWTP, we applied high-throughput sequencing-based metagenomic approach using the Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform.
